title: LPD Explorer Post 468 Takes 3rd Place at State Explorer Competition in Corpus Christi
excerpt: Laredo Police Department Explorer Post 468 brought home third place in the Police Nature Unknown Scenario at the 9th Annual John Sartain Memorial Law Enforcement Explorer Competition in Corpus Christi.
content:
Laredo Police Department Explorer Post 468 earned third place in the Police Nature Unknown Scenario at the 9th Annual John Sartain Memorial Law Enforcement Explorer Competition in Corpus Christi, Texas. The department announced the result Tuesday, Nov. 17.

The Explorers — young people training for careers in law enforcement — represented Laredo at the statewide competition, where teams from departments across Texas test their skills in realistic police scenarios judged by officers.

The department credited the Explorers' teamwork, determination and professionalism, and thanked the Explorer Advisors who trained and mentored the team for the competition.

The John Sartain Memorial competition is a long-running Texas Explorer event held in Corpus Christi, drawing teams from departments across the state.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 17, 2026.
